title: Baptism of Mihály Demkó, 20 August 1882
kind: Parish baptism register, one entry cut from a page
collector_label: Baptism of Mihaly Demko 1882 - Cicarovce Son of Gyorgy Demko and Maria Hresko

register.parish: Not visible. The file name says Cicarovce (Čičarovce, Hungarian Csicser, Ung county).

fields.note: Written above the entry. The third digit is cramped; the next entry's year is a clear 1882 and the file name agrees.
The ditto-like strokes beside it fill the unused sub-columns.
gk. = görög katolikus. gazda = a peasant holding his own land.
The initial is ornate; read as H by comparison with the godmother's surname.

fields.english: Viszoka (today Vysoká nad Uhom), house no. 132

fields.original: Varga Mih. r.k. / Hreskó Anna r.k.
fields.english: Mihály Varga, Roman Catholic; Anna Hreskó, Roman Catholic
fields.note: The godmother carries the mother's maiden surname: probably her kin.
Surname only. Could also be read Emrgovich or Cmrgovich. Needs another entry in the same hand.

translation: No. 36. 1882. Born 19 August, baptised 20 August: Mihály, a boy, legitimate. Parents: György Demkó, Greek Catholic, farmer, and Mária Hreskó, Roman Catholic. Residence: Viszoka, house no. 132. Godparents: Mihály Varga, Roman Catholic, and Anna Hreskó, Roman Catholic. Baptised by Csurgovich (reading uncertain). No remarks.
notes: The image is a strip 157 pixels high. No page header, parish name, page number or film number is visible, so the register is identified only by the collector's file name.
The entry above (no. 35) and the one below are partly visible and name other families; they are not transcribed.
The child was born at Viszoka, not at Čičarovce. If the label is right, Čičarovce is where the book was kept.

Added at DM-B-003 on a second look: the entry below, of which only the top line shows, has the residence 'Vaján' (Vojany) and the officiant 'Polányi Endre'. Two different priests officiate on one page.
